notes.title: The Ghost and the Golem is a finalist for the Nebula Game Writing Award!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that [i]The Ghost and the Golem[/i] is a finalist for the Nebula Game Writing Award!

[i]The Ghost and the Golem[/i] is an interactive historical fantasy novel by Benjamin Rosenbaum. Confront mystic perils and revelations, pogroms, & your own wild heart, in a Jewish historical fantasy of bandits, betrothals, klezmers, and kabbalists!

To celebrate, we are also putting every previous Nebula Finalist game on sale.

Check out our Nebula Finalists bundle on Steam for an even bigger discount!

Since 1965, the Nebula Awards have been given annually to the best works of science fiction and fantasy published that year, as voted on by the members of the Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers of America (SFWA). The awards will be presented in a ceremony on Saturday, June 7, 2025 that will be streamed live as it is held in-person in Kansas City, MO as part of the 60th Annual Nebula Awards Conference.

notes.title: Elul Update
notes.notes:
Release Notes
------------------
 Bugfixes:
    - Fixed dramatis personae, which was mostly blank (!!)
    - Fixed some other bugs
    - Got rid of stat inflation entirely, since the "turn off stat inflation" seems to have been a little wonky & unreliable.

UI:
    - Implemented glossary paging on mobile (at least, I think I did: I can't test it.)

Identity & Romance:
    - You can reveal trans/intersex identity to suitor during shiddukh, eliciting various reactions. (You can also fill Rivka in that you did this, in chapter 6.)
    - more depth in general, in the conversation with suitor during the shidddukh
    - There are more ways to come out as trans, to various degrees, in the epilogue, and more summary of what that looks like in various romantic and professional configurations
   
Relationships:
    - Improved relationship text (particularly for Moysheh/Basha pining for you after being rejected, and Mamma's reactions in general)
